title: Warning Light Bar 38" – Amber/White for Trucks
descriptionHtml:
Be seen and warn others on the worksite

On construction sites and in traffic it's important that heavy vehicles are clearly visible. Good warning lights increase safety for both drivers and those around them.

38 inches with amber and white light

This light bar is 38 inches long and glows in both amber and white. It's made for construction and safety lighting on trucks.

Features

  • 38-inch light bar
  • Amber and white light
  • For construction and safety lighting
  • Durable and weatherproof
  • Great for trucks and work vehicles

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
